description: This file defines the JsonRpcParser class that specializes in parsing JSON-RPC responses for AWS services, particularly for protocols like DynamoDB. It implements methods to construct the parser, invoke parsing on responses, parse the response based on its output shape, and handle stream parsing.

classes.name: JsonRpcParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling JSON-RPC responses, tailored for AWS services like DynamoDB. It extends AbstractParser and uses PayloadParserTrait to implement parsing logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a service description and an optional JSON parser.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Enables the object to be called as a function, parsing a response for a given command.

methods.name: parseResponse
methods.description: Parses a response based on the JSON RPC protocol, handling normal and event stream responses.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses a specific member from the response stream using the JSON parser.
